result:
**All tests pass.** ✓

The vulnerability was in `get_invoice_handler` calling `service.store.get(invoice_id)` directly instead of `service.get(invoice_id, user)`. This bypassed the `_owned()` permission check in the service layer. The fix now ensures all invoice reads go through the service, which verifies the user owns the invoice before returning it (raises `FORBIDDEN` otherwise).
